sentiment_score_definition: x <= -0.35: Bearish; -0.35 < x <= -0.15: Somewhat-Bearish; -0.15 < x < 0.15: Neutral; 0.15 <= x < 0.35: Somewhat_Bullish; x >= 0.35: Bullish
relevance_score_definition: 0 < x <= 1, with a higher score indicating higher relevance.

feed.title: Delta Air Lines Is Launching Its First Direct Route to Saudi Arabia
feed.summary: Delta Air Lines is set to launch its first direct route to Saudi Arabia, with nonstop service between Atlanta (ATL) and Riyadh (RUH) beginning October 23, 2026. This new route will operate daily initially, then transition to three times weekly, using Delta’s Airbus A350-900 aircraft. The expansion follows a 2024 partnership agreement with Riyadh Air, connecting over 150 North American markets to Riyadh.

feed.title: Bath & Body Works sets Sept. 4 dividend payment for shareholders
feed.summary: Bath & Body Works (NYSE: BBWI) has declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.20 per share. This dividend is scheduled to be paid on September 4, 2026, to shareholders who are on record as of the close of business on August 21, 2026. The announcement highlights the company's ongoing commitment to returning value to its shareholders through regular dividend payments.

feed.title: Rosenblatt Securities Reiterates Buy Rating for Microchip Technology (NASDAQ:MCHP)
feed.summary: Rosenblatt Securities has reiterated its "Buy" rating for Microchip Technology (NASDAQ:MCHP), setting a $120 price target, which suggests a significant upside of 61.38%. This comes after Microchip Technology surpassed quarterly expectations with $0.76 adjusted EPS and $1.48 billion in revenue, coupled with an optimistic fiscal second-quarter EPS guidance. Despite a positive analyst consensus, concerns remain regarding the stock's elevated valuation and recent insider selling.

feed.title: Why KLA (KLAC) Is Up 7.1% After Dividend Hike And Strong 2026 Outlook Update
feed.summary: KLA Corporation (KLAC) stock rose 7.1% following a dividend hike and a strong outlook update for 2026. The company declared a quarterly cash dividend of US$0.23 per share and provided guidance for the September 2026 quarter, projecting US$4.0 billion in revenue and US$1.14 GAAP diluted EPS. This positive news reinforces KLA's investment narrative, particularly concerning its essential role in semiconductor process control, while analysts continue to assess potential risks like export tariffs and customer concentration.

feed.title: RBC Adjusts PT on Akamai Technologies to $135 From $150, Maintains Sector Perform Rating
feed.summary: RBC has adjusted its price target for Akamai Technologies (AKAM) to $135, down from $150, while maintaining a Sector Perform rating. This update reflects a revised valuation for the company. Akamai Technologies is a leading provider of Internet applications and content distribution services, focusing on content distribution, application development, and data management.

feed.title: Deutsche Bank Adjusts Keurig Dr Pepper Price Target to $32 From $30, Maintains Hold Rating
feed.summary: Deutsche Bank has increased its price target for Keurig Dr Pepper Inc. (KDP) shares to $32 from the previous $30, while reiterating a "Hold" rating on the stock. This adjustment comes amidst other financial news for Keurig Dr Pepper, including its Q2 2026 earnings report showing adjusted earnings and net sales increases. The company also reaffirmed its 2026 net sales forecast, projecting between $25.9 billion and $26.4 billion.

feed.title: Super Micro Q4 Earnings Preview: What To Expect From Upcoming Report
feed.summary: Super Micro Computer (NASDAQ:SMCI) is set to release its fiscal fourth-quarter results on August 11, with analysts expecting significant growth in both earnings and revenue. The company has updated its outlook, indicating a backlog exceeding $60 billion and improved gross margin projections. Despite this positive outlook, Wall Street remains cautious, focusing on execution, cash flow, and competitive pressures in the AI server market.

feed.title: Mission Produce® to Host Investor Day on October 8, 2026
feed.summary: Mission Produce, Inc. (NASDAQ: AVO) announced it will host an Investor Day in New York City on Thursday, October 8, 2026. The event will begin at 10:00 a.m. ET and will highlight the Company’s strategic priorities and long-term growth plans. This event follows its acquisition of Calavo Growers and John Pawlowski’s transition to Chief Executive Officer.

feed.title: Xcel Energy Foundation Turns 25 With $160M Invested In Local Nonprofits Since 2001
feed.summary: The Xcel Energy Foundation is celebrating 25 years of community giving, having invested over $160 million in various organizations since 2001. This includes $82 million in grants to local non-profits and $73.6 million from employee contributions. Last year alone, the foundation supported 151 Minnesota non-profits with $5.4 million, alongside significant employee volunteer hours and environmental initiatives.

feed.title: PPL Corp misses second-quarter profit estimates as costs weigh
feed.summary: PPL Corp reported that it missed second-quarter profit estimates due to significant costs weighing on its financial performance. Despite this, the company reaffirmed its 2026 outlook. Analysts have provided varying price targets for PPL, with a mean consensus to "BUY" the stock.

feed.title: Autozi Internet Technology (Global) Ltd. (Nasdaq: AZI) Announces Letter of Intent for Proposed Reverse Takeover Transaction with Privately Held Operating Company
feed.summary: Autozi Internet Technology (Global) Ltd. (Nasdaq: AZI) has announced a letter of intent for a proposed reverse takeover transaction with a privately held operating company. This transaction is expected to transform Autozi into a significantly larger Nasdaq-listed platform with an estimated combined valuation of approximately $320 million. Autozi shareholders will continue to hold equity interests in the combined company and benefit from future growth opportunities.

feed.title: AIG’s General Insurance Q2 Underwriting Income Up 10%
feed.summary: American International Group's (AIG) General Insurance segment reported a nearly 10% increase in Q2 2026 underwriting income, reaching $686 million, despite higher catastrophe losses including $75 million related to the Middle East conflict. CEO Eric Anderson noted the company's strong performance in a transitioning market, highlighting the importance of underwriting expertise and portfolio diversity. Overall net income attributable to AIG shareholders decreased due to investments in Corebridge and equity security, though AIG gained $710 million from selling its remaining Corebridge interest.

feed.title: Trade Desk Posts Downbeat Q2 Results, Joins Sezzle, Resmed, Ouster And Other Big Stocks Moving Lower In Friday’s Pre-Market Session
feed.summary: The Trade Desk (NASDAQ: TTD) reported weaker-than-expected Q2 financial results, with earnings per share missing estimates by 15% and revenue falling short of Street estimates. This news caused Trade Desk shares to drop significantly in pre-market trading, impacting other stocks such as Sezzle, Quidelortho, and Ardelyx, which also saw declines after reporting disappointing quarterly results or guidance.

feed.title: Why Emerson Electric (EMR) Is Up 5.6% After Raising Guidance And Expanding Its Industrial AI Push
feed.summary: Emerson Electric (EMR) reported strong third-quarter fiscal 2026 results, including higher sales and net income, and raised its full-year guidance. The company also announced a significant expansion into industrial AI, appointing a new Chief Technology and AI Officer and launching new AI-enabled platforms. This strategic shift aims to move Emerson towards higher-value industrial software and AI solutions, supporting its long-term investment narrative despite risks associated with cyclical markets and competition.

feed.title: The Bull Case For Aramark (ARMK) Could Change Following Dividend Payout And New UCCS Deal
feed.summary: Aramark recently approved a quarterly dividend of US$0.12 per share and announced a long-term partnership with the University of Colorado Colorado Springs (UCCS) for campus hospitality services. These developments reinforce Aramark's strategy of combining capital returns with expansion in the education sector. While the UCCS deal supports Aramark's core growth drivers in higher education, the company's investment narrative remains sensitive to cost control in a tight labor market and potential pressure on contract economics in cyclical client sectors.

feed.title: Sensors, Space Cameras and Power Systems Meet at Teledyne Booth 711
feed.summary: Teledyne will showcase its integrated defense, space, and advanced technology solutions at the 2026 Space & Missile Defense Symposium in Huntsville, Alabama. The company will highlight its capabilities in sensing, imaging, microelectronics, advanced packaging, and power systems, crucial for national security, space exploration, and missile defense missions. Visitors to Booth 711 can explore solutions including visible and infrared sensors, radiation-hardened semiconductors, and various power systems.

feed.title: AMETEK Sets Sept. 30 Payment Date for Its $0.34 Dividend
feed.summary: AMETEK (NYSE: AME) has declared a regular quarterly dividend of $0.34 per share for the third quarter ending September 30, 2026. This dividend is payable on September 30, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 15, 2026. The company, a global provider of industrial technology solutions with approximately $7.5 billion in annual sales, targets double-digit percentage earnings per share growth and superior return on total capital.

feed.title: Morgan Stanley, Texas Stock Exchange could light up Dallas skyline
feed.summary: The Dallas City Plan Commission has approved signage proposals for the Texas Stock Exchange (TXSE) and Morgan Stanley, moving them closer to adding their brands to the Dallas skyline. The TXSE ticker will overlook Klyde Warren Park, and Morgan Stanley's signage will be at Fountain Place. This development signifies the Dallas region's growing prominence as "Y'all Street" and a major destination for Wall Street investment.

feed.title: Alpha Q2 Loss Reflects Weak Coal Market
feed.summary: Alpha Metallurgical Resources Inc. (NYSE: AMR) reported a net loss in Q2 2026 due to weak global metallurgical coal prices, lower shipment volumes, and operational disruptions, leading to a lowered full-year shipment outlook and increased production cost guidance. Despite the challenges, Alpha maintained a strong balance sheet and continued its stock repurchase program. The company attributes much of the increased cost pressure to temporary operational issues and remains confident in its long-term position, anticipating recovery as steel demand improves.

feed.title: B&G Foods Announces Retirement of CEO Casey Keller, Selection of Successor
feed.summary: B&G Foods has announced the retirement of its President and CEO, Kenneth C. “Casey” Keller, after five years with the company. Keller's retirement is effective August 7, and he will assist with the leadership transition. The Board of Directors has already selected his successor, who currently holds a senior leadership position at another public company, and an announcement is expected soon.

feed.title: Federal Realty Investment Trust Prices $400 Million Exchangeable Senior Notes Offering
feed.summary: Federal Realty Investment Trust has priced an offering of $400 million in exchangeable senior notes. The REIT specializes in owning, operating, and redeveloping retail-based properties, primarily in major coastal markets. This news follows several recent analyst rating adjustments and their Q2 2026 earnings report.

feed.title: Take-Two sticks to annual bookings outlook, says on track for 'GTA VI' November launch
feed.summary: Take-Two Interactive maintained its annual bookings forecast and reiterated the November 19 launch date for "Grand Theft Auto VI." Despite projecting current-quarter bookings below Wall Street estimates due to a lack of new titles, the company expects "GTA VI" to be a major revenue driver, building on the success of its predecessor, "GTA V." Investors are also keenly watching for details on a potential online, multiplayer mode for "GTA VI," which could provide a consistent revenue stream similar to "GTA V Online."

feed.title: Angel Oak Mortgage REIT Is Maintained at Overweight by Wells Fargo
feed.summary: Wells Fargo has maintained its "Overweight" rating on Angel Oak Mortgage REIT. This indicates the analyst firm believes the stock is likely to perform better than the broader market or its sector. Investors often use such ratings as part of their decision-making process.

feed.title: (TTWO) Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. Expects Q2 Revenue Range $1.42B - $1.47B
feed.summary: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (TTWO) anticipates its Q2 revenue to fall within the range of $1.42 billion to $1.47 billion. This announcement follows their fiscal Q1 results where the loss widened but revenue increased. The company has also reiterated its fiscal 2027 guidance, with an expected revenue range of $7.90 billion to $8.10 billion and an EPS range of $0.55 to $0.75.

feed.title: American Airlines changes elite upgrades on select routes
feed.summary: American Airlines is changing its elite upgrade policy on select routes, limiting complimentary upgrades from the main cabin to premium economy instead of business class. This change, effective August 25, 2026, applies to specific domestic and Hawaii routes, particularly those with three cabin classes. The airline states this streamlining aims to deliver a more consistent customer experience as it expands its premium economy offerings.

feed.title: DENTSPLY SIRONA (NASDAQ:XRAY) Issues Earnings Results
feed.summary: DENTSPLY SIRONA (NASDAQ:XRAY) announced its quarterly earnings, reporting an adjusted EPS of $0.52, beating consensus estimates of $0.35, with revenue of $898 million, slightly above expectations. Despite this beat, revenue declined 4.1% year-over-year, and the company maintained its 2026 guidance, anticipating sequential declines in Q3 due to seasonality and investments. Analysts hold a consensus "Hold" rating for the stock, with insiders recently increasing their holdings.

feed.title: Insider Selling: AudioCodes (NASDAQ:AUDC) EVP Sells 2,812 Shares of Stock
feed.summary: AudioCodes EVP Lior Aldema sold 2,812 shares of the company's stock for $27,726.32 on August 5th, under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan, reducing his ownership by 2.50%. This transaction occurred after AudioCodes reported better-than-expected quarterly earnings and revenue, and announced a $0.20 per-share dividend. The stock currently holds a consensus "Hold" rating from analysts.

feed.title: Niran Baruch Sells 1,875 Shares of AudioCodes (NASDAQ:AUDC) Stock
feed.summary: AudioCodes CFO Niran Baruch sold 1,875 shares of the company's stock for $18,656.25, reducing his ownership by 1.82%. The transaction was conducted under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 plan. AudioCodes recently reported strong quarterly earnings, beating analyst estimates for both EPS and revenue, and issued positive fiscal 2026 EPS guidance.

feed.title: Bank of America Corp DE Sells 39,808 Shares of Old Dominion Freight Line, Inc. $ODFL
feed.summary: Bank of America Corp DE reduced its stake in Old Dominion Freight Line, Inc. (NASDAQ:ODFL) by 5.6% in the first quarter, selling 39,808 shares and retaining 671,156 shares valued at $131.1 million. Despite this, other institutional investors increased their holdings, and 77.82% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors. The company reported strong Q1 earnings, beating analyst estimates with an EPS of $1.68 and a 10.4% year-over-year revenue increase, and declared a quarterly dividend of $0.29 per share.

feed.title: PSE&G Urges Customers to Prepare for Dangerous Heat and the Possibility of Isolated Thunderstorms and Wind
feed.summary: PSE&G is urging customers to prepare for dangerous heat and possible isolated thunderstorms with high winds, as the heat index is expected to exceed 100 degrees. The utility has additional personnel ready to respond to potential outages and advises customers to stay safe, informed, and manage energy use during peak hours. They emphasize safety measures like staying away from downed power lines and having backup plans for medical equipment.

feed.title: Grand Theft Auto VI set for Nov. 19 as Take-Two repeats $8.0B-$8.2B outlook
feed.summary: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. reported its first-quarter fiscal year 2027 results, with net bookings slightly above guidance at $1.39 billion. The company reiterated its fiscal year 2027 net bookings outlook of $8.0 billion to $8.2 billion, driven by strong performance and the anticipated launch of Grand Theft Auto VI on November 19th. Despite a GAAP net loss of $34.1 million, Take-Two highlighted growth in recurrent consumer spending and provided detailed financial outlooks for the fiscal year and the upcoming quarter.

feed.title: PPL Corporation Delivers Solid Second-Quarter 2026 Earnings; Reaffirms Guidance and Long‑Term Growth Outlook
feed.summary: PPL Corporation reported solid second-quarter 2026 earnings, with ongoing earnings per share of $0.33, up from $0.32 in 2025. The company reaffirmed its 2026 ongoing earnings forecast of $1.90 to $1.98 per share and its annual EPS growth target of 6% to 8% through at least 2029. PPL also highlighted potential investment opportunities of $10 billion to $12 billion through 2032 from economic development in Pennsylvania and Kentucky, primarily driven by data center growth.

feed.title: Vistra stock edges down on second quarter revenue miss By Investing.com
feed.summary: Vistra Corp. (NYSE:VST) reported second-quarter 2026 revenue of $4.02 billion, missing the analyst consensus of $5.73 billion, causing its stock to edge down 1.22% in pre-market trading. Despite the revenue miss, the company saw a 31% increase in Ongoing Operations Adjusted EBITDA to $1.77 billion and reaffirmed its full-year 2026 guidance. Vistra also announced a new joint venture, Helix Digital Infrastructure, and received approval for its Cogentrix Energy acquisition.

feed.title: Alpha Announces Financial Results for Second Quarter 2026
feed.summary: Alpha Metallurgical Resources, Inc. reported a net loss of $12.3 million for the second quarter of 2026 and adjusted EBITDA of $25.6 million. The company's CEO, Andy Eidson, attributed the results to fewer tons shipped and higher costs than expected, leading to adjusted guidance for sales volumes and coal sales costs. Alpha is also addressing damage at Dominion Terminal Associates due to a high-wind storm, which will impact future efficiency.

feed.title: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. Reports Results for Fiscal First Quarter 2027
feed.summary: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. reported its fiscal first quarter 2027 results, with Net Bookings slightly exceeding guidance at $1.39 billion. The company reiterated its fiscal year 2027 Net Bookings outlook of $8.0 to $8.2 billion, driven by strong portfolio performance and anticipation for the Grand Theft Auto VI launch. GAAP net loss for the quarter was $34.1 million, impacted by a $43.4 million impairment charge for an unannounced title.

feed.title: FAA orders inspections of Boeing 737 MAX jets over possible fuselage cracks (BA:NYSE)
feed.summary: The FAA has mandated inspections for hundreds of Boeing 737 MAX jets after the discovery of cracks in the structural reinforcement around service doors on older models. This directive from the Federal Aviation Administration aims to address potential fuselage cracks in the aircraft. The news could impact The Boeing Company (BA) stock.

feed.title: UAE/Abu Dhabi: Another Morgan Stanley Banker Lands Top Investment Role at Adnoc
authors: Dinesh Nair and Anthony Di Paola
feed.summary: Abu Dhabi National Oil Co. (Adnoc) has appointed Michael O’Dwyer, Morgan Stanley’s global co-head of energy investment banking, as its new chief investment officer. This marks another instance of Adnoc recruiting top talent from Wall Street, as O’Dwyer succeeds Klaus Froehlich, who also joined Adnoc from Morgan Stanley and was instrumental in expanding the oil giant's global investment platform. Adnoc continues to tap major banks for expertise to support its ambitious global dealmaking strategy.

feed.title: PensionDanmark Pensionsforsikringsaktieselskab Increases Stake in Welltower Inc. $WELL
feed.summary: PensionDanmark Pensionsforsikringsaktieselskab increased its holdings in Welltower Inc. (NYSE:WELL) by 7.3% during the second quarter, bringing its total ownership to 106,240 shares valued at $24.11 million. This move is part of a broader trend where several institutional investors have either purchased new stakes or significantly increased their positions in the real estate investment trust. Analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating for Welltower, with a consensus target price of $246.11, following recent price target increases by several firms.

feed.title: Assurant, Inc. Just Beat Analyst Forecasts, And Analysts Have Been Updating Their Predictions
feed.summary: Assurant, Inc. (NYSE:AIZ) recently reported strong second-quarter results, with shares gaining 4.9% and statutory profit exceeding analyst expectations by 16%. Analysts have since updated their forecasts, increasing their earnings per share estimates and raising the consensus price target to US$310, indicating increased optimism for the company's intrinsic value and its ability to grow faster than the industry.

feed.title: Wynn Resorts, Limited Just Beat Analyst Forecasts, And Analysts Have Been Updating Their Predictions
feed.summary: Wynn Resorts, Limited recently reported its quarterly results, with revenues in line with expectations but statutory earnings per share significantly beating estimates by 34%. Despite the positive earnings surprise, analysts have not substantially changed their revenue or EPS forecasts for 2026, and the consensus price target remains at US$133. The company's revenue growth is projected to slow to 2.0% annually, underperforming the broader industry's expected 9.4% growth.

feed.title: Truist Adjusts Price Target on DaVita to $215 From $250, Maintains Hold Rating
feed.summary: Truist has lowered its price target for DaVita (NYSE: DVA) to $215 from $250, while reiterating a "Hold" rating on the stock. This adjustment comes amidst other analyst actions on DaVita, with some firms raising and others adjusting their price targets, and follows DaVita's recent Q2 2026 earnings report.

feed.title: Honeywell Aerospace Tumbles on Disappointing Debut Report, but Bull Case Remains Intact
feed.summary: Honeywell Aerospace (HONA) shares dropped significantly after its first-quarter report as a standalone company, missing earnings expectations and cutting organic growth guidance. Despite the disappointing debut, analyst Jim Cramer and Wall Street maintain a bullish outlook due to the company's substantial $18 billion backlog, 8% aftermarket growth, and tailwinds from increased defense spending. The mean analyst target price of $245 suggests a strong long-term thesis for HONA, outweighing the initial poor performance.

feed.title: EMP Metals Reaches Critical Milestone as Project Aurora Moves Toward Commercial Lithium Production
feed.summary: EMP Metals Corp. has completed construction and is 50% finished with commissioning its Project Aurora lithium brine demonstration plant in Saskatchewan, aiming for a Q3 startup. This milestone transitions the project from infrastructure building to generating critical operational data, which will derisk the commercial scale-up by establishing accurate operating costs, refining capital estimates, and optimizing design. The direct wellhead connection of the plant ensures realistic data collection for a future 6,000 tonnes per year commercial facility, with a potential initial phase at 1,500 tonnes per year, leveraging Saskatchewan's cleaner brine chemistry for more efficient production.

feed.title: Lazard Hires Barclays Veteran Sheth for European Tech Push
feed.summary: Lazard Inc. is bolstering its technology advisory team by hiring Jessel Sheth, a veteran banker from Barclays Plc. Sheth, joining as a managing director in November, will focus on software and related sectors, aiming to assist Lazard's software clients navigating AI-driven disruption in the European market. This strategic hire underscores Lazard's commitment to strengthening its tech advisory capabilities.

feed.title: Earnings Flash (VST) Vistra Corp. Reports Q2 Revenue $4.02B, vs. FactSet Est of $5.46B
feed.summary: Vistra Corp. (VST) reported its second-quarter revenue of $4.02 billion, falling short of the FactSet estimate of $5.46 billion. The company's Q2 net income and operating revenue both experienced a decline. Vistra Corp. is an integrated retail electricity and power generation company operating a diverse fleet of power generation facilities.
